Drone Scout
Know if the weather lets you fly, before you drive to the field.
Pre-flight mission planner for survey drones · NVIDIA Earth-2 + 6-DOF physics
The problem
A wind forecast says “10 mph”. It does not say what your drone will do.
Battery
Headwind and gusts drain more than a calm day. Will one pack finish the field?
Survey quality
Gusts push the drone off its lanes, and image overlap breaks.
Wasted trips
You find out at the field, after the drive, that you cannot fly.
Drone Scout · GatorHack 5
Our idea
Fly the mission in the forecast, two days early.
1
Forecast
NVIDIA Earth-2 StormCast ensemble at your field: wind, gusts, rain, air density, visibility.
2
Simulate
Fly the real survey route for every launch hour and every scenario in our drone simulator.
3
Decide
CLEARED, CONDITIONAL or NOT CLEARED, plus battery needed and the best launch hour.

One verdict for every launch hour
09:00 is CLEARED. By 11:00 gusts and dust make it NOT CLEARED.
Reasons are stated: gusts over 10 m/s, visibility under the FAA 3-mile minimum, tilt margin.
37 flights simulated: 8 hours × 4 forecast scenarios.

Every limit has a source, and we label the guesses
Limit
Value
Basis
Temperature
0–40 °C
DJI P4 Multispectral spec
Visibility
3 miles
FAA 14 CFR 107.51(c)
Wind and gusts
10 m/s
Assumed: P4 family figure

0.5 mm/h

30° of 35°

Every number in the app is tagged SPEC, DERIVED or ASSUMED
How it works
Where physics meets computer applications.
Physics
Rigid-body flight: thrust, drag, wind, turbulence and air density, integrated at 500 Hz.
AI weather
NVIDIA Earth-2 StormCast gives an ensemble of forecast scenarios at the field.
Software
An interactive planner that turns hundreds of simulated flights into one clear decision.
Checked against hand calculations, so the numbers behind each verdict can be trusted.
